parts.text: Deal risk gate test for a logistics and trade-finance team. We are evaluating a USD 2.4m shipment of industrial equipment on route Altynkol -> Aktau/Kuryk -> Baku -> Poti. Counterparties: Kazakhstan forwarder, Azerbaijan port agent, Georgian consignee. Sources supplied: port operator notice dated 2026-05-20; OFAC/EU/UK sanctions list extract dated 2026-05-21 with no exact matches; carrier note dated 2026-05-22. Missing: no beneficial ownership extract, no counterparty registry extract, no insurance clause, no customs source, no vessel or carrier history. Question: should this be escalated before contract signature, and what minimum evidence is needed before go?
